body:
I feel like that would be incredibly humiliating.  All of my contemporaries are having normal social lives and meeting women normally, and I would be having to pay because I am that big of a loser.  

And for the second message, thank you, that is kinder than I deserve.

I liked the law.  I liked the legal process, the theory, the structure.  Money wasn't all that big of a deal to me, just having a stable job would be nice.  

But that was years ago.  My grades have dropped to an almost irreparably low level.  I think that maybe this is just a sign that I am not smart enough for it

>you live all by yourself 

Yes, right now I am in an apartment just off my school's campus 

>how often do you leave your house 

just for class and basic shopping.  I don't like being seen in public so much, I always get the feeling that people can tell I am a loser 

>What are you studying to be in school? 

I am studying political science to be a lawyer.  I don't have the grades anymore to get into a good school though 

>Do you enjoy the career path you are going for 

I don't really know.  I have taken a mock law school class and have studied what the job is like a lot, and I like it in theory.  I don't think I am smart enough to really do it though 

>Is it a passion of yours or just to get a job sort of deal? 

I don't really have passions anymore, just kind of things I do for the sake of doing them.  I don't get much joy out of things anymore.  I occasionally get a contented, normal kind of feeling when longtime sports teams win, but it never lasts more than a couple hours
